name: AquaClimber
desc: A limbed swimming and climbing multi-modal robot. The first to freestyle swim and transition to vertical climbing, AquaClimber uses pendular motion and a design similar to the Bipedal Oscillating RoBot (BoB) robots. Coded with Arduino.

name: ET-Quad / STARQ
desc: The multi-modal swimming, climbing, and running quadruped designed for NASA's 2022 Big Idea Challenge and further developed for research. STARQ has multi-modal limbs and is run using a raspberry pi, moteus motor controls & motors, and Python script.

name: SELQIE-Underwater Explorer
desc: The Seafloor Environment Legged Quadruped Intelligent Explorer (SELQIE) is designed to traverse multiple aquatic modes- walking underwater, swimming mid-fluid, and transitioning between locomotive modes. SELQIE is run on a Jetson ORIN with a ROS2 framework.

name: RR-STARQ, bio-inspired surface swimmer
desc: A quadrupedal, revolute-revolute modification of previous robot, STARQ, mimics biology such as dogs when surface swimming. A sagittal plane MATLAB model is used to simulate results and compare to experimentation.

name: Muli-modal C-shaped foot design
desc: A more in-depth look at the design and hardware development of the multi-modal limb design of STARQ.

name: Leg Locomotion in Fluid
desc: Nelder-Mead optimization was run in a simulated fluid bed to aid in tuning optimization of a five-bar leg running while submerged in fluid.

name: MiniBobCat- Concept
desc: Prototype of a smaller scale quadruped. Used and experimented on before designing and developing STARQ.

name: PropBoB
desc: Prototype of a propellor assisted climbing BoB robot.

name: Mechatronics & Art
desc: Collaborative work with sculpture students to create an interactive engineer/art installment at the Sharing Tree, Tallahassee.

name: DAVEs - Dynamics And Vibrations Experimentation systems
desc: Hardware built for Systems and Vibration class's lab experimentation section. One DAVE is used for all labs, with interchangeable parts for experimental learning.

name: Senior Design - Flax Fiber Composite for Sikorsky Aircraft
desc: My team created an environmentally conscious, flax fiber based composite and characterized samples to evaluate probability of use on or in aircraft.
